description: A bounded 12-response open-web pass found no in-month report establishing an actual Lesotho public gathering of at least 50 people making a demand on the Lesotho state. Searches included English and Sesotho terms, general Jan 2023 and half-month windows, Maseru and named districts, and public-service, health, education, student, factory and worker queries. Search results were noisy and frequently out of period.
required_followup: If further time is available, consult additional contemporaneous district and sector sources; do not treat this pass as proof that no event occurred.

required_followup: Coverage remains open for contemporaneous local reporting, archive completeness, and any January onset/continuation evidence.
